findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed rusting on the shelves of the kitchen’s standing freezer. Nonfood contact surfaces should be maintained to be smooth, and easily cleanable. Reseal or replace shelving by the next routine inspection.

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent; (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated WAREWASHING; (D) Finished to have a SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface; and (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. [C]

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11 (O) Two current employees did not have signed reporting agreements on file. One employee started several months ago and the other just started within the recent weeks. PIC had employees sign copies of the reporting agreement during the inspection All other staff, including the PIC, had signed reporting agreements on file. Additional copies of the reporting agreement were provided. Ensure all staff are educated on the employee health policy upon hiring, and maintain signed copies of reporting agreements for staff. 
The person in charge shall ensure that food employees are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with law, to the person in charge, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food, as specified under ¶ 2-201.11(A).

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15 Leak was observed at the plumbing under the far right wash basin at the 3 part sink in the kitchen. PIC was made aware and will inform maintenance of the issue so repairs can occur. A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 Two of the five spray bottles of quat sanitizer used in classrooms tested at 0-100ppm. The other three solutions were at 200ppm. Solutions below 200ppm were emptied during inspection. Director plans to begin using Purell Foodservice Surface Sanitizer in all the classrooms (see general comments for details). 

A quaternary ammonia compound solution shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions and be maintained at the concentration as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling.
NOTE: Whatever product is used for sanitizing, make sure it is maintained at proper concentration per product label.
